race.description: Great Northern Qtis 3yo Fillies Mdn Plate
race.comment: DOUBLE COOL (3) was no match for the heavily backed and what looks smart Invincible Chase but still did a great job to manage the rest. Fitter now and is drawn cosy. Ready to get off the mark now. CLOUDED THOUGHTS (2) was well backed in her second outing after an eye-catching debut effort, and while she couldn't get the job done last time she lost no admirers. Should be nearing her top now and keeps Maloney piloting, though he will need to be on top of his game from the wide draw. HARD MISS (5) was only claimed late here on debut in the wet after leading them up. Gets a key switch in Thompson and is drawn to land right on speed again. Can go one better. GLORIOUS REBEL (16) looks pick of the debutants with some neat trials under her belt. Mallyon partnering for Dunn is always a good push too. Keeping onside.
